Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses AP-MS to identify disulfide-dependent interactors of peroxiredoxins. While the study focuses on cysteine oxidation/disulfides, the MS analysis itself is a standard bottom-up LFQ approach following affinity purification. Acquisition is inferred as DDA based on the use of Orbitrap Fusion and MaxQuant for LFQ protein identification.

scope: the remaining supernatant was used for immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag-M2 affinity gel
For the identification of cysteine-dependent interactors the lysate of 4 × 20 cm dishes were used for each pulldown on 75 μL of Flag-M2 beads
Flag-PRDX1-5 were pulled-down along with their interactors and subsequently exposed to a stringent high-salt wash to diminish non-covalent interactors.
